description: This file contains mock implementations of CSI (Container Storage Interface) client interfaces for testing purposes, including identity, node, and controller clients, with methods to simulate volume operations and capabilities.

classes.name: IdentityClient
classes.description: Mock CSI identity client used for testing, with methods to get plugin info and capabilities.

classes.name: CSIVolume
classes.description: Data structure representing a CSI volume with handle, context, paths, and filesystem info.

classes.name: NodeClient
classes.description: Mock CSI node client for testing volume publish, unpublish, stage, unstage, expand, and capability discovery.

classes.name: ControllerClient
classes.description: Mock CSI controller client for testing volume management operations and capabilities.

methods.name: SetNextError
methods.description: Injects an expected error to be returned on next method call.

methods.name: Probe
methods.description: Performs a probe operation (stubbed as nil).

methods.name: NodePublishVolume
methods.description: Simulates publishing a volume to a target path, creating necessary directories or files.

methods.name: NodeUnpublishVolume
methods.description: Simulates unpublishing a volume, removing the target path.

methods.name: NodeGetCapabilities
methods.description: Returns node capabilities, including support for staging, expansion, volume stats, volume condition, multi-writer, and mount group.

methods.name: ControllerGetCapabilities
methods.description: Returns controller capabilities, including publish/unpublish volume.
